thresholds.note: historical WL81 engineering gates (eval81.representation_gate), unchanged, used as the comparison point

steps.rule: predeclared on the gate set: for each fit arm, Delta = |median(12000) - median(6000)| of its own objective metric on the gate EVALUATION set (E_L1 for metric arms, E_shape for shape arms). Converged iff Delta <= 0.005. A non-converged arm is fitted at 24000 steps on the gate set and on every holdout / real set, and its 24000-step fits are its primary fits (one escalation, no further change); the label OPTIMISATION_LIMITED is attached if Delta(24000 vs 12000) > 0.005 too. The perturbed-init spread is reported (not a rule).
